hook: BT Group acquired TalkTalk Telecommunications Limited and PlatformX Communications Limited out of administration.

sections.voiceover: BT Group acquired TalkTalk Telecommunications Limited and PlatformX Communications Limited out of administration.
On October 5, 2026, TalkTalk entered administration and was sold to BT. BT acquired the consumer units to protect 2.5 million customers. Where did lenders send their complaints?
Except the largest lender fired off bitter complaints straight to ministers and the CMA.
The Competition and Markets Authority launched a merger inquiry regarding BT's completed acquisition. BT paid $530 million for the deal. Regulators served statutory orders.
BT secured the £400 million purchase instantly.
